versions.changelog:
Initial release: Generate whiteboard-style hand-drawing animation videos from images.

- Converts any color image into a two-stage animation (line drawing & coloring) with realistic hand overlay.
- Supports single image and batch processing modes.
- Outputs H.264 MP4 videos; images with white backgrounds work best.
- Includes full setup script for environment and dependencies.
- Returns final video paths (single) or summary info (batch), with progress and error reporting.
